d: Underground of an ancient abandoned church; long ruined staircase that puts at the door - on one side a small exit leading to a vestibule inhabited by Martha. Some faded images and lamps here and there on the walls. From a wide crack of the vault appears a strip of sky. The Knight of Nua among a mat of Armati.
The Count of Bergh, Martha and sayings.
Martha descends from the upper door that closes; then Ilda.
Spanish Captains' Hall. Spanish Dukes and Soldiers, Velasco, Ruggero and Diego.
Garden in the house of Margherita. Margherita and Ancelle grouped by flowerbeds; then Ruggero.
Prison. Ilda lying on the ground, leaning her head to a rugged stool.
The main square of Antwerp. On one side a very high wooden cross, above a large stone base. At the end of the cathedral. - It is dawn. A patrol of Spanish soldiers slowly crosses the scene.

The wedding court that moves to the church. Soldiers and Cortigiani, Knights and Dames of the house of Velasco and the Following of Margherita. During the unfolding of this scene a multitude of men hidden in brown capes surrounds and clumsy little by little the square. The Count of Bergh is among those.
Old prison in the fortress of Antwerp. On the right a door, a little door on the left. It burns a lamp at the top of the first, in front of an image.
The Count of Bergh from the door to the right. He is without weapons, pale and excited. He moves slowly towards Ruggiero and strangely guating him.
Ilda followed by a Man of arms down, advancing softly.
Bergh - Soldiers rushing in with him in torches light.
